title: レストラン・バーの口語表現

items.en: Hi there. Do you have a table for two? We don't have a reservation.
items.jp: こんにちは。2名の席はありますか？予約はしていません。
items.speak: Hi there. Do you have a table for two? We don't have a reservation.

items.en: Let me check. The wait's about thirty minutes, or you can sit at the bar.
items.jp: 確認します。待ち時間は30分ほどで、バー席ならすぐ座れます。
items.speak: Let me check. The wait's about thirty minutes, or you can sit at the bar.

items.en: Bar's fine with me. Whatever gets us fed the fastest.
items.jp: 僕はバーでいい。一番早く食べられるならどこでも。
items.speak: Bar's fine with me. Whatever gets us fed the fastest.

items.en: Is the kitchen open late? We might hang around for a while.
items.jp: 厨房は遅くまでやってる？しばらくいるかもしれなくて。
items.speak: Is the kitchen open late? We might hang around for a while.

items.en: What's good here? I can't decide between the burger and the tacos.
items.jp: ここは何がおいしい？バーガーとタコスで決められない。
items.speak: What's good here? I can't decide between the burger and the tacos.

items.en: Both are solid. But if you wanna try something different, the skewers are kinda famous.
items.jp: どっちも間違いない。でも違うものなら、串焼きがちょっと有名だよ。
items.speak: Both are solid. But if you wanna try something different, the skewers are kinda famous.
items.note: 元の形: want to／kind of／聞こえ方: ワナ／カインダ／使う場面:勧める時

items.en: I'd split the fries with you, if you want.
items.jp: ほしければ、フライを半分こしよう。
items.speak: I'd split the fries with you, if you want.

items.en: We're ready to order. One skewer plate, the tacos, and fries to share.
items.jp: 注文をお願いします。串焼きプレートと、タコスと、シェア用のフライを。
items.speak: We're ready to order. One skewer plate, the tacos, and fries to share.

items.en: Got it. Anything to drink?
items.jp: 承知しました。お飲み物は？
items.speak: Got it. Anything to drink?
items.note: 元の形: I have it／聞こえ方: ガット／使う場面:了解を伝える時

items.en: I'm allergic to peanuts, pretty seriously. Can you tell the kitchen?
items.jp: ピーナッツのアレルギーがかなり重いんです。厨房に伝えてもらえますか？
items.speak: I'm allergic to peanuts, pretty seriously. Can you tell the kitchen?

items.en: Cross-contamination is a real concern for me.
items.jp: 交差汚染が、本当に心配なんです。
items.speak: Cross-contamination is a real concern for me.

items.en: Our fryer's shared, so I'd skip anything fried, to be safe.
items.jp: フライヤーは共用なので、念のため揚げ物は避けた方がいいです。
items.speak: Our fryer's shared, so I'd skip anything fried, to be safe.

items.en: Can you make sure the kitchen knows it's an allergy, not a preference?
items.jp: 好みではなくアレルギーだと、厨房に必ず伝えてもらえますか？
items.speak: Can you make sure the kitchen knows it's an allergy, not a preference?

items.en: I ordered the chicken, but this looks like the steak.
items.jp: チキンを頼んだのに、これはステーキみたい。
items.speak: I ordered the chicken, but this looks like the steak.

items.en: We've been waiting for our drinks for about twenty minutes now.
items.jp: 飲み物をもう20分ほど待っています。
items.speak: We've been waiting for our drinks for about twenty minutes now.

items.en: Lemme talk to the bartender. Gimme two minutes.
items.jp: バーテンダーに話してきます。2分ください。
items.speak: Lemme talk to the bartender. Gimme two minutes.
items.note: 元の形: let me／give me／聞こえ方: レミ／ギミ／使う場面:対応を約束する時

items.en: Since the mix-up was our fault, the drinks are on us tonight.
items.jp: こちらの間違いなので、今夜の飲み物は当店負担にします。
items.speak: Since the mix-up was our fault, the drinks are on us tonight.

items.en: Could you box this up? We might have to leave soon.
items.jp: これを箱に詰めてもらえますか？急いで出るかもしれなくて。
items.speak: Could you box this up? We might have to leave soon.

items.en: Is this seat taken? Everywhere else looks full.
items.jp: この席、空いてますか？ほかは全部埋まってるみたい。
items.speak: Is this seat taken? Everywhere else looks full.

items.en: I'm just waiting for a friend, and she's, like, forty minutes late.
items.jp: 友達を待ってるだけで、彼女は、もう40分遅れてる。
items.speak: I'm just waiting for a friend, and she's, like, forty minutes late.

items.en: You wanna try a sip? It's a local stout, super smooth.
items.jp: ひと口飲んでみる？地元のスタウトで、すごく滑らかだよ。
items.speak: You wanna try a sip? It's a local stout, super smooth.
items.note: 元の形: do you want to／聞こえ方: ワナ／使う場面:勧める時

items.en: I'm more of a wine person, but sure, why not.
items.jp: 私はワイン派だけど、いいわよ、せっかくだし。
items.speak: I'm more of a wine person, but sure, why not.

items.en: Don't tell my friends I said that. It's actually good.
items.jp: 友達には言わないでね。これ、実はおいしい。
items.speak: Don't tell my friends I said that. It's actually good.

items.en: To Maya's promotion. You earned it. Cheers!
items.jp: マヤの昇進に。当然の結果だよ。乾杯！
items.speak: To Maya's promotion. You earned it. Cheers!

items.en: You're gonna make me cry in the middle of a bar.
items.jp: バーの真ん中で泣かせないでよ。
items.speak: You're gonna make me cry in the middle of a bar.
items.note: 元の形: going to／聞こえ方: ガナ／使う場面:冗談めかして言う時

items.en: Who's picking up the check? I'm broke until Friday.
items.jp: 会計は誰が持つの？金曜まで一文無しなんだ。
items.speak: Who's picking up the check? I'm broke until Friday.

items.en: Let's split it evenly. Four people, easy math.
items.jp: 均等に割ろう。4人だから計算も楽だ。
items.speak: Let's split it evenly. Four people, easy math.

items.en: I only had a salad and a soda. Can we get separate checks?
items.jp: サラダとソーダだけだったよ。別々の伝票にしてもらえる？
items.speak: I only had a salad and a soda. Can we get separate checks?

items.en: Is there any chance we could move to another table? It's really loud over here.
items.jp: 別のテーブルに移れませんか？こちらはとてもうるさくて。
items.speak: Is there any chance we could move to another table? It's really loud over here.

items.en: I don't wanna ruin their party, but I can't even hear my friend.
items.jp: 彼らのパーティーを台無しにしたくないけど、友達の声さえ聞こえない。
items.speak: I don't wanna ruin their party, but I can't even hear my friend.
items.note: 元の形: want to／聞こえ方: ワナ／使う場面:遠慮して言う時

items.en: There's a quiet booth by the window. Lemme set it up for you.
items.jp: 窓際に静かなボックス席があります。準備しますね。
items.speak: There's a quiet booth by the window. Lemme set it up for you.
items.note: 元の形: let me／聞こえ方: レミ／使う場面:手配を始める時

items.en: Could we get the check, please? We're gonna head out.
items.jp: お会計をお願いします。そろそろ出ます。
items.speak: Could we get the check, please? We're gonna head out.
items.note: 元の形: going to／聞こえ方: ガナ／使う場面:これからやると言う時

items.en: Can you walk me through the charges? The total's higher than I expected.
items.jp: 内訳を説明してもらえますか？合計が思ったより高くて。
items.speak: Can you walk me through the charges? The total's higher than I expected.

items.en: An automatic eighteen percent service charge is included for large parties.
items.jp: 大人数のお客様には、自動で18%のサービス料が入っています。
items.speak: An automatic eighteen percent service charge is included for large parties.

items.en: Not unless you wanna leave something extra for great service.
items.jp: 素晴らしいサービスだと思えば別ですが、そうでなければ不要です。
items.speak: Not unless you wanna leave something extra for great service.
items.note: 元の形: want to／聞こえ方: ワナ／使う場面:任意だと言う時

items.en: Hey, Dana, nice to meet you. What are you drinking?
items.jp: ねえダナ、はじめまして。何を飲んでるの？
items.speak: Hey, Dana, nice to meet you. What are you drinking?

items.en: Dude, the lamb skewers are unreal. Try one.
items.jp: なあ、ラムの串焼きは最高だよ。食べてみて。
items.speak: Dude, the lamb skewers are unreal. Try one.

items.en: Man, that was the best fish taco I've ever had.
items.jp: うわ、今まで食べた中で一番おいしいフィッシュタコスだった。
items.speak: Man, that was the best fish taco I've ever had.

items.en: Sir, can I get you another round?
items.jp: お客様、もう一杯いかがですか？
items.speak: Sir, can I get you another round?

items.en: Babe, you want dessert or should we go?
items.jp: ねえ、デザートいる？それとも行く？
items.speak: Babe, you want dessert or should we go?
items.note: 元の形: do you／聞こえ方: ユー／使う場面:問いかける時

items.en: Buddy, this one's on me. Don't even argue.
items.jp: おい、これは僕のおごり。言い返さないで。
items.speak: Buddy, this one's on me. Don't even argue.

items.en: Dunno. What's the soup of the day?
items.jp: さあ。今日のスープは何？
items.speak: Dunno. What's the soup of the day?
items.note: 元の形: I don't know／聞こえ方: ダノウ／使う場面:迷っている時

items.en: Beats me why it's taking so long.
items.jp: なぜこんなに時間がかかるのか分からない。
items.speak: Beats me why it's taking so long.
items.note: 元の形: it beats me／聞こえ方: ビーツミー／使う場面:理由が分からない時

items.en: Ya think they'll give us a discount for the wait?
items.jp: 待たせたから、割引してくれると思う？
items.speak: Ya think they'll give us a discount for the wait?
items.note: 元の形: do you think／聞こえ方: ヤ シンク／使う場面:意見を聞く時

items.en: Whatcha having? Everything looks so good.
items.jp: 何にする？全部おいしそうだね。
items.speak: Whatcha having? Everything looks so good.
items.note: 元の形: what are you／聞こえ方: ワッチャ／使う場面:気軽に聞く時

items.en: Didja see the specials board? There's a crab pasta.
items.jp: おすすめの黒板見た？カニのパスタがあるよ。
items.speak: Didja see the specials board? There's a crab pasta.
items.note: 元の形: did you／聞こえ方: ディジャ／使う場面:出来事を伝える時

items.en: I gotta try the dessert. People keep raving about it.
items.jp: デザートは試さなきゃ。みんなが絶賛してるから。
items.speak: I gotta try the dessert. People keep raving about it.
items.note: 元の形: have got to／聞こえ方: ガラ／使う場面:やりたいことを言う時

items.en: We hafta leave by ten. My babysitter's waiting.
items.jp: 10時までに出なきゃ。ベビーシッターが待ってるんだ。
items.speak: We hafta leave by ten. My babysitter's waiting.
items.note: 元の形: have to／聞こえ方: ハフタ／使う場面:期限を言う時

items.en: Y'know, I come here every Friday, and it never gets old.
items.jp: ほら、毎週金曜にここへ来るけど、飽きないんだ。
items.speak: Y'know, I come here every Friday, and it never gets old.
items.note: 元の形: you know／聞こえ方: ヤノウ／使う場面:しみじみ言う時

items.en: Long story short, they comped our drinks.
items.jp: 要するに、飲み物をおごってくれたんだ。
items.speak: Long story short, they comped our drinks.
